propositions: Integration fixture _load_module unconditionally replaces sys.modules[canonical_key], allowing distinct module object B to shadow the original object A that AdfCodec retains a reference to

Serial test ordering causes integration round-trip fixture to run before unit cutover test, leaving AdfCodec bound to stale module A while monkeypatching is applied only to replacement module B, causing codec output to diverge from test expectations

By-path loader must return cached module when both canonical name and __file__ match the requested source to preserve the documented canonical-module identity invariant and prevent fixture-induced state leakage across test order variations
Runtime identity matrix proves codec output follows the pinned module object exclusively; monkeypatching the replacement module has no effect on codec behavior while the original module remains bound
